name: IUCN NL Land Acquisition Fund

funder.name: IUCN National Committee of the Netherlands (IUCN NL)

summary: Fund for locally registered conservation NGOs and civil society organisations in Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Pacific to buy or lease land and set up other area-based protection that secures habitat for threatened species. Grant size is set in the applicant guidelines.

geography.label: Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Pacific

status.quote: The deadline for applications is Friday, 1 May, 2026.

deadline.quote: The deadline for applications is Friday, 1 May, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: be locally registered as a non-profit organisation, non-governmental organisation (NGOs) or civil society organisation (CSOs) in Africa, Asia, Latin America, or the Pacific

geography.quote: be locally registered as a non-profit organisation, non-governmental organisation (NGOs) or civil society organisation (CSOs) in Africa, Asia, Latin America, or the Pacific

access.quote: The IUCN NL Land Acquisition Fund calls on local conservation NGOs and CSOs worldwide to submit proposals to acquire threatened nature, create safe reserves, and connect habitats for endangered species.

window.quote: The deadline for applications is Friday, 1 May, 2026.
